title: Beams, Sticky Grids, Container Tone, Wobble & :open
description: Five live drops: an SVG animated-beam node diagram, a scroll-pinned grid choreography, zero-JS container-style-query typography, wobble feature cards, and the freshly cross-browser :open pseudo-class.

drops.title: Beam Hub
drops.description: Gradient light comets travel along SVG paths from satellite nodes into a central hub, pulsing the node on arrival.
drops.concept: Reimplements the 'animated beam' pattern popular on AI/SaaS landing pages for 'how it works' diagrams: quadratic-bezier SVG paths are computed live from real DOM node positions, then a bright dashed overlay path animates its stroke-dashoffset to look like a traveling light segment. Tunable node count, curvature, speed and direction.
drops.source: Inspired by Magic UI's Animated Beam component

interaction.mouse: Watch beams travel automatically; use the panel to change node count, curvature, speed
interaction.click: Reverse direction or cycle beam color from the top-right panel
interaction.touch: Fully automatic — no interaction required on mobile

drops.title: Sticky Grid Scroll
drops.description: A pinned 3x3 grid choreographs reveal, zoom and title phases as you scroll through its 420vh wrapper.
drops.concept: Reimplements a Codrops scroll-driven grid tutorial's structure without GSAP: a sticky wrapper stays pinned while an internal 0-to-1 scroll progress value (computed from the wrapper's bounding rect) drives three phases — staggered column reveal, grid zoom with side-column horizontal shift, then a title overlay fade-in — all via requestAnimationFrame-throttled transform updates.
drops.source: Inspired by a Codrops scroll-driven grid tutorial

interaction.mouse: Scroll the page to advance the pinned grid's animation timeline
interaction.click: Use the panel's Auto-scroll demo button to play the sequence hands-free
interaction.touch: Swipe to scroll through the pinned section on mobile

drops.title: Container Tone
drops.description: Flip one custom property on a container and a headline's entire typographic mood changes, resolved purely by @container style().
drops.concept: Demonstrates CSS container style queries reacting to custom properties: each card is a style-query container carrying a --tone variable; four @container tone style(--tone: X) blocks each restyle the same h2 markup into a distinct register (serif editorial, glowing neon, technical mono, whisper-thin) with zero JavaScript touching element styles — only the custom property changes.
drops.source: Inspired by web.dev's coverage of container style queries for custom properties

interaction.mouse: Hover cards to see the glow accents respond
interaction.click: Click a tone button to flip that card's --tone property; drag the intensity slider for the continuous demo below
interaction.touch: All buttons and the slider are touch-friendly

drops.title: Wobble Cards
drops.description: Feature cards lean toward the cursor with layered icon parallax, springing back the instant the pointer leaves.
drops.concept: Reimplements Aceternity UI's Wobble Card: on pointermove, the card's translate3d offset is computed from the cursor's position relative to the card center, the icon inside parallaxes at a higher multiplier for depth, and a radial highlight follows the cursor. A cubic-bezier overshoot transition handles the spring-back on pointerleave. Touch taps trigger a damped one-shot wobble instead of continuous tracking.
drops.source: Inspired by Aceternity UI's Wobble Card

interaction.mouse: Move across any card to see it lean and its icon parallax
interaction.touch: Tap a card for a quick damped wobble pulse

drops.title: The :open Selector
drops.description: One pseudo-class styles three different native elements' open state — an accordion, a popover menu, and a dialog.
drops.concept: Showcases the :open pseudo-class (Baseline newly available across Chrome/Firefox/Safari as of May 2026), which matches <details>, <dialog>, and any popover element whenever it is in its open state. A details-based FAQ accordion uses details:open plus a CSS-grid 0fr-to-1fr track trick for height animation; a popovertarget-triggered menu uses [popover]:open with @starting-style entrance transitions; and a <dialog> confirm modal uses dialog:open/::backdrop with a small JS-timed exit animation. No class-toggling JavaScript drives any of the visual open-state styling.

interaction.mouse: Click any summary, the Actions button, or Open confirm dialog to see the shared :open styling fire
interaction.click: Same as mouse — all three are click-triggered
interaction.touch: Fully tap-friendly; the dialog and popover both support tap-outside dismiss
